apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata: {name: vuoro-cloud, namespace: flux-system}
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: https://github.com/bayleafwalker/vuoro-cloud.git
  ref:
    semver: ">=0.1.0-0 <0.2.0-0"
  secretRef: {name: vuoro-cloud-github-git-read}
  verify:
    mode: TagAndHEAD
    secretRef: {name: vuoro-cloud-promotion-keys}
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata: {name: vuoro-cloud-operators, namespace: flux-system}
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./clusters/operators
  prune: true
  sourceRef: {kind: GitRepository, name: vuoro-cloud}
  wait: true
  timeout: 10m
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata: {name: vuoro-cloud-platform, namespace: flux-system}
spec:
  dependsOn: [{name: vuoro-cloud-operators}]
  interval: 10m
  path: ./clusters/vuoro-cloud-poc
  prune: true
  sourceRef: {kind: GitRepository, name: vuoro-cloud}
  wait: true
  timeout: 10m
  # The GHCR pull Secret is SOPS-encrypted; decrypting it
  # requires an in-cluster `sops-age` Secret the operator creates out-of-band
  # (never committed) — e.g. `flux create secret sops-age
  # --namespace=flux-system --agekey-file=~/.config/sops/age/vuoro-cloud.txt`.
  # Until that Secret exists, this Kustomization will fail to reconcile.
  decryption: {provider: sops, secretRef: {name: sops-age}}
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata: {name: vuoro-cloud-apps, namespace: flux-system}
spec:
  dependsOn: [{name: vuoro-cloud-platform}]
  interval: 10m
  path: ./clusters/vuoro-cloud-poc-apps
  prune: true
  sourceRef: {kind: GitRepository, name: vuoro-cloud}
  # Keep application readiness observable separately from platform/operator
  # readiness; compatibility publication and tenant-runtime reconciliation
  # remain independent release gates.
  wait: false
  timeout: 10m
